_meta.name: Verbs acceptance requirements knowledge base
_meta.purpose: Curated standard of libibverbs/rdma-cm/mlx5dv acceptance scenarios so the skill is self-contained. Matched against (a) how the source uses verbs and (b) what the verbs test corpus already covers, to decide what to PROPOSE.

classes.MUST-PASS: Hard baseline; capability officially supported. Missing => FAIL, not skip.
classes.CONDITIONAL: Version/capability gated (atomics, dmabuf, ionic, relaxed-ordering, 2-node); skip allowed but log reason + gate.
classes.REGRESSION: Targets a known issue / recovery path; a hang/timeout/crash is the signal.

_meta.fields: id, title, area, class, gate, signal_apis[], sequence[], known_issue, description, verify, impl_hint, provenance_hint, scenario_key, match_names[]

requirements.title: vat_device_enum
requirements.description: Enumerate devices, query ports, validate the GID table.
requirements.verify: Device list non-empty; ports queryable; GID table valid.

requirements.title: vat_pd_cq_mr
requirements.description: PD/CQ/MR lifecycle across all access-flag combinations.
requirements.verify: All create/destroy succeed; MR usable under each access-flag combo.

requirements.title: vat_rc_qp_capacity
requirements.description: Verify advertised QP limits (max_send_wr=512, max_recv_wr=256, inline_data).
requirements.verify: Queried caps match the requested/advertised limits.

requirements.title: vat_relaxed_ordering
requirements.description: Register MRs with IBV_ACCESS_RELAXED_ORDERING; confirm ops complete correctly under relaxed PCIe ordering with no silent corruption.
requirements.verify: RDMA under relaxed-ordering MR completes with no corruption; SKIP if flag unsupported.

requirements.title: vat_ece_negotiation
requirements.description: Enhanced Connection Establishment: ibv_query_ece on a QP, exchange the ECE struct with the peer, ibv_set_ece to negotiate the vendor/options bits, then bring the QP to RTS. RCCL negotiates ECE during connect. SKIP if ECE unsupported.
requirements.verify: ECE queried/set without error; QP connects with negotiated parameters; SKIP if unsupported.

requirements.title: vat_reg_mr_iova2
requirements.description: Register an MR with an explicit IOVA via ibv_reg_mr_iova2 (the IOVERBS 1.8 API RCCL cherry-picks), then RDMA over it. Some NIC drivers have failed this path on VMM-mapped symmetric VAs. A successful reg + transfer is the pass; EFAULT on a valid mapping is the regression signal.
requirements.verify: iova2 registration succeeds and RDMA over the MR works; EFAULT on a valid buffer flags the regression.

requirements.title: vat_mlx5dv_create_qp
requirements.description: Create a QP via the mlx5 Direct-Verbs path (mlx5dv_create_qp with ibv_qp_init_attr_ex + mlx5dv_qp_init_attr) rather than plain ibv_create_qp — the provider-specific creation RCCL uses for mlx5 features. Bring it to RTS and run a transfer. SKIP on non-mlx5 NICs.
requirements.verify: DV-created QP reaches RTS and transfers correctly; SKIP on non-mlx5.

requirements.title: vat_srq_lifecycle
requirements.description: Shared-receive-queue path: ibv_create_srq -> post receives to the SRQ -> drive RDMA/SEND into it -> ibv_destroy_srq. RCCL's GDA-KI verbs wrapper uses SRQ; the plan only tests per-QP recv. Verify shared receives are consumed correctly.
requirements.verify: Scenario completes correctly; SKIP cleanly when the gated capability is absent.

requirements.title: vat_ah_lifecycle
requirements.description: Address-handle create/destroy paired explicitly, including repeated create/destroy to catch AH leaks. The plan creates AHs (in UD) but never tests teardown in isolation.
requirements.verify: Scenario completes correctly; SKIP cleanly when the gated capability is absent.

requirements.title: vat_rc_qp_lifecycle
requirements.description: RC QP INIT->RTR->RTS. Reliable, delivery-guaranteed connection - the absolute baseline.
requirements.verify: QP reaches RTS; reliable transfer works.

requirements.title: vat_ud_qp_lifecycle
requirements.description: UD QP with QKEY, AH, SEND_WITH_IMM + receive. Unreliable, broadcast-style connection.
requirements.verify: UD send/recv with imm delivered.

requirements.title: vat_ud_grh_handling
requirements.description: Verify the 40-byte GRH prefix on UD receive.
requirements.verify: Received UD payload offset by the 40B GRH; GRH parsed correctly.

requirements.title: vat_rdma_write
requirements.description: RDMA_WRITE with data-integrity check (64 B - 1 MB).
requirements.verify: Remote buffer matches the written pattern across sizes.

requirements.title: vat_rdma_read
requirements.description: RDMA_READ from a remote MR, including a passive QP (0 send/recv).
requirements.verify: Local buffer equals the remote source after read.

requirements.title: vat_rdma_write_with_imm
requirements.description: RDMA_WRITE_WITH_IMM; encode/decode the 32-bit immediate; verify it arrives correctly.
requirements.verify: imm_data received intact alongside the payload.

requirements.title: vat_rdma_write_chain
requirements.description: N-WR chain with only the last WR signaled; verify all payloads land.
requirements.verify: All chained payloads delivered; one completion for the signaled WR.

requirements.title: vat_inline_send
requirements.description: RDMA_WRITE with IBV_SEND_INLINE (24 B, no MR).
requirements.verify: Inline payload delivered without a registered MR.

requirements.title: vat_atomic_fetch_add
requirements.description: Chained RDMA_WRITE + ATOMIC_FETCH_AND_ADD.
requirements.verify: Atomic add result correct after the preceding write.

requirements.title: vat_gpu_flush_loopback
requirements.description: Self-loopback RC QP with RDMA_READ (GPU flush path).
requirements.verify: Loopback read completes; flush path validated.

requirements.title: vat_dmabuf_mr
requirements.description: ibv_reg_dmabuf_mr with GPU memory (HIP + HSA export).
requirements.verify: DMABUF MR registers over GPU memory; SKIP if dmabuf unavailable.

requirements.title: vat_gpu_rdma_write
requirements.description: RDMA_WRITE between DMABUF GPU buffers. Run per export version v1 and v2_pcie - they behave differently across hardware.
requirements.verify: GPU buffer written correctly under both dmabuf export versions.

requirements.title: vat_gpu_rdma_read
requirements.description: RDMA_READ from a DMABUF GPU buffer + GPU flush loopback. Run per export version v1 and v2_pcie. Read and Write are separate driver code paths.
requirements.verify: GPU read correct under both export versions.

requirements.title: vat_gpu_atomic
requirements.description: Atomics over DMABUF GPU memory: Fetch-and-Add and Compare-and-Swap. Requires atomic support at the PCIe and NIC driver level.
requirements.verify: FAA + CAS over GPU memory produce correct results.

requirements.title: vat_hipalloc_x_ibvreg
requirements.description: Matrix of 7 allocation modes (device malloc, pinned host, fine-grain, managed, ...) x 3 registration methods = 21 cases, each a separate CI line; RDMA_WRITE verifies data is transferred.
requirements.verify: Each of the 21 alloc x reg combos transfers data correctly or skips cleanly.

requirements.title: vat_write_then_atomic_visibility
requirements.description: Sender writes payload, then atomic-increments a counter. Receiver observes the counter, then reads the data. Verify payload is guaranteed visible in GPU HBM at the moment the atomic becomes visible (ordering preserved).
requirements.verify: Data visible in GPU HBM when the atomic increment becomes visible.

requirements.title: vat_writeimm_data_visibility
requirements.description: RDMA_WRITE_WITH_IMM. Verify that when the receiver observes completion (imm_data arrived), the payload is already fully visible in GPU HBM - the NIC must not signal completion before data lands.
requirements.verify: Payload fully visible in GPU HBM at the moment the imm completion is observed.

requirements.title: vat_atomic_wakeup_gpu_stream
requirements.description: A GPU kernel polls a value in memory; a remote NIC atomic-increments it via RDMA. Verify the kernel wakes - the NIC write is visible to the GPU without extra CPU-side barriers.
requirements.verify: GPU polling kernel observes the NIC atomic update without a CPU barrier.

requirements.title: vat_rc_qp_reset_recovery
requirements.description: Recover a downed RC QP via SQErr->Reset->Init->RTR->RTS and resume transfer without tearing down the full connection; also cover destroy+recreate.
requirements.verify: QP recovers and resumes transfer; destroy+recreate path also works.

requirements.title: vat_cqe_error_codes
requirements.description: Generate WR_FLUSH_ERR; verify shared-CQ isolation.
requirements.verify: Error CQE has expected status; other QPs on the shared CQ unaffected.

requirements.title: vat_qp_err_transition
requirements.description: QP->ERR mechanics, outstanding-WR drain, RESET.
requirements.verify: Outstanding WRs flush on ERR; RESET succeeds.

requirements.title: vat_ionic_ionic_features
requirements.description: Vendor NIC feature bits.
requirements.verify: Vendor feature bits accepted; SKIP on unsupported hardware.

requirements.title: vat_ionic_reset_broken
requirements.description: Detect a QP RESET-recovery failure; verify destroy+recreate recovery path.
requirements.verify: RESET-failure detected; destroy+recreate restores a working QP.

requirements.title: vat_async_event_monitor
requirements.description: Async-event path RCCL runs as a background monitor (net_ib/common.cc): ibv_get_async_event blocks for NIC events (port down/active, QP fatal error, etc.), the handler decodes the type and ibv_ack_async_event releases it. Trigger an event (e.g. force a QP to error) and verify it is delivered and acked without leaking. The signal RCCL uses to detect NIC/link failures for recovery.
requirements.verify: An induced async event (QP fatal / port change) is delivered, decoded, and acked; no leak/hang.

requirements.title: vat_fork_init
requirements.description: fork-safety init: call ibv_fork_init before registering MRs (RCCL does this at net init, net_ib.cc / init.cc), then fork() a child and confirm RDMA memory in the parent is not corrupted by COW. Without fork_init, registered pages can be silently broken across fork.
requirements.verify: After ibv_fork_init + fork, parent's registered buffers stay intact for RDMA.

requirements.title: vat_2node_rdma_write_imm
requirements.description: Cross-node RDMA_WRITE_WITH_IMM round-trip.
requirements.verify: Cross-node write+imm round-trips correctly.

requirements.title: vat_2node_qp_recovery
requirements.description: Cross-node QP recovery with QPN re-exchange.
requirements.verify: QP recovers across nodes after QPN re-exchange.

requirements.title: vat_2node_ud_recovery_protocol
requirements.description: Full UD recovery protocol: alive->ACK->QPN-exchange.
requirements.verify: UD recovery handshake completes and transfer resumes.

requirements.title: Gdr_HandleForAddressRange_Export
requirements.description: cudaGetDevice -> cuMemGetHandleForAddressRange -> hsa_amd_portable_export_dmabuf -> fd+offset for NIC GDR registration. Verify valid fd+offset (later registerable via ibv_reg_dmabuf_mr in the mixed test).
requirements.verify: Valid fd+offset returned; registerable by ibv_reg_dmabuf_mr.

requirements.title: DmaBuf_DeviceAttr_Probe
requirements.description: dmaBufSupported: cudaDriverGetVersion (>=11070 gate) -> cuDeviceGet -> cuDeviceGetAttribute(DMA_BUF_SUPPORTED); on the HSA path assert hsa_amd_portable_export_dmabuf resolved. Report dma_buf availability; gates Gdr_HandleForAddressRange_Export.
requirements.verify: dma_buf availability reported; gates the GDR export test.

requirements.title: vat_device_caps_probe
requirements.description: Beyond vat_device_enum: ibv_query_device (full device_attr: atomic_cap, max_qp/mr/srq), ibv_get_device_name, ibv_query_port_ex (extended port attrs), rate helpers. Report the capability matrix that gates the CONDITIONAL tests (atomics, SRQ, DEVX).
requirements.verify: Scenario completes correctly; SKIP cleanly when the gated capability is absent.

requirements.title: vat_mlx5dv_device_probe
requirements.description: Probe the mlx5 Direct-Verbs provider: mlx5dv_is_supported(device) -> mlx5dv_query_device -> mlx5dv_init_obj to obtain low-level QP/CQ objects. Verify the provider initializes and reports caps. SKIP on non-mlx5 NICs.
requirements.verify: Scenario completes correctly; SKIP cleanly when the gated capability is absent.

requirements.title: vat_mlx5dv_dmabuf_mr
requirements.description: mlx5dv_reg_dmabuf_mr - the Mellanox-specific GPU-dmabuf registration RCCL uses as an alternative to ibv_reg_dmabuf_mr. Register GPU memory, RDMA_WRITE, verify. SKIP with reason on EOPNOTSUPP/EPROTONOSUPPORT. Distinct driver path from generic vat_dmabuf_mr.
requirements.verify: Scenario completes correctly; SKIP cleanly when the gated capability is absent.

requirements.title: vat_devx_obj_lifecycle
requirements.description: DEVX object lifecycle: obj_create -> obj_query -> obj_modify -> obj_destroy, plus devx_general_cmd and devx_query_eqn. The DEVX command path the GDA-KI backend builds QPs/CQs on. SKIP if DEVX unavailable.
requirements.verify: Scenario completes correctly; SKIP cleanly when the gated capability is absent.

requirements.title: vat_devx_uar_umem
requirements.description: DEVX resource mapping: devx_alloc_uar/free_uar (UAR doorbell pages) and devx_umem_reg/reg_ex/dereg (user-memory registration). Verify alloc/register/teardown round-trips. SKIP if DEVX unavailable.
requirements.verify: Scenario completes correctly; SKIP cleanly when the gated capability is absent.
